the test.bin build of main.bin's http_request_step (0x0C11D320): (no arguments): the per-frame request state machine on the active slot (http_ring_active). While the slot waits on the board (+0x120 == 1) it takes the result when channel 0 of the slot's socket is done (http_board_done_locked, http_board_result_take) or counts a wait frame (http_wait_tick), and returns until 9600 (0x2580) frames have passed, then forces state 8. Otherwise by state +0x11c: 1 saves the slot into http_slot_backup and goes to 2; 2 http_socket_create_step; 3 http_connect_step; 4 http_send_step; 5 http_recv_step; 6 http_close_step then 7 (reply ready) and http_active_advance; any step whose code is neither 0 (done) nor 1 (wait) goes to 8. State 8 stores the error code in http_failed_code and falls into 9, which closes the socket and on success restores the slot from http_slot_backup (the request runs again from state 1) and counts it in http_retry_total; a failed close gives state 10 (dead). Clears http_wait_frames each pass; callers FUN_0c020380, FUN_0c020500; part of naomi2lib/libnl2http/src/http.c
